commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
BRANCH=work/photomap-straighten-20260912
SHA=eca60d3932ef1ab3ad2f99957a4271eab3e8c77b
MAIN_SHA=dcd99f07faf9e159a1b6b3f0b76ccff1e9db8ce1
git fetch origin "$BRANCH" main
test "$(git rev-parse origin/$BRANCH)" = "$SHA"
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$MAIN_SHA"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git switch --detach "$SHA"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SHA"
git diff --check "$MAIN_SHA" "$SHA"
VENV=$(mktemp -d /tmp/photomap-final-123-XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$VENV"; ./scripts/devctl.sh stop >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
python3 -m venv "$VENV"
"$VENV/bin/python" -m pip install -q -r backend/requirements.txt
"$VENV/bin/python" -m pytest -q backend
cd frontend
npm run format:check
npm run lint
npm run knip
npm run build
npm run test
PYTHON="$VENV/bin/python" npm run test:e2e -- --project=chromium --grep-invert 'visual:'
cd ..
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git fetch origin "$BRANCH" main
test "$(git rev-parse origin/$BRANCH)" = "$SHA"
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$MAIN_SHA"
printf 'verified_sha=%s\nmain_sha=%s\n' "$SHA" "$MAIN_SHA"
trap - EXIT
rm -rf "$VENV"
./scripts/devctl.sh stop >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
